"""Offline continuation checks: consumed jobs and failed sources stay consumed."""
import importlib.util
import runpy
from pathlib import Path

import pytest
from core import colab_artifacts as a

HERE=Path(__file__).parent.absolute()
SCRIPT=HERE/'run_paced_schedule_unattempted.py'
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('original_generated_scheduler_tests',HERE/'test_paced_metadata.py')
original=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(original)

@pytest.fixture
def setup(tmp_path,monkeypatch):
 f=original.environment.__wrapped__(tmp_path,monkeypatch)
 (f/'batches').mkdir()
 (f/'paced-logs').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
 (f/'unattempted-continuation-contract.json').write_bytes(a.encode({'source_sha256':{}}))
 def start(**kwargs):return original.schedule(f,monkeypatch,**kwargs)
 return f,start


def test_new_source_uses_separate_log_and_completion(setup):
 f,start=setup
 calls=start()
 # The original helper checks the suffix and resource/opt-in command contract.
 runpy.run_path(str(SCRIPT),run_name='__main__')
 assert len(calls)==1
 assert (f/'continued-schedule-completion.json').exists()
 assert not(f/'paced-schedule-completion.json').exists()
 assert (f/'continued-logs/batch-9000.log').exists()


@pytest.mark.parametrize('marker',['attempt','log'])
def test_consumed_pre_network_job_not_retried(setup,marker):
 f,start=setup;calls=start()
 path=f/('batches/batch-9000.attempt.json' if marker=='attempt' else 'paced-logs/batch-9000.log')
 path.write_bytes(b'old evidence')
 runpy.run_path(str(SCRIPT),run_name='__main__')
 assert not calls and path.read_bytes()==b'old evidence'
 assert not(f/'continued-logs/batch-9000.log').exists()


@pytest.mark.parametrize('prior',['intent','result'])
def test_previous_upstream_sha_never_retried(setup,prior):
 f,start=setup;calls=start(prior=prior)
 runpy.run_path(str(SCRIPT),run_name='__main__')
 assert not calls


def test_old_reservation_budget_not_reset(setup):
 f,start=setup;calls=start(debit=512*a.MIB)
 runpy.run_path(str(SCRIPT),run_name='__main__')
 assert not calls


@pytest.mark.parametrize('binding',['old','new','manifest'])
def test_all_bindings_checked_before_child(setup,binding):
 f,start=setup;calls=start(source_mismatch=binding=='old',manifest_mismatch=binding=='manifest')
 if binding=='new':
  marker=f/'new-bound-source';marker.write_bytes(b'actual')
  (f/'unattempted-continuation-contract.json').write_bytes(a.encode({'source_sha256':{str(marker.relative_to(Path.cwd())):'0'*64}}))
 with pytest.raises(ValueError,match='mismatch'):runpy.run_path(str(SCRIPT),run_name='__main__')
 assert not calls


def test_nonzero_child_is_not_automatically_retried(setup):
 f,start=setup;calls=start(returncode=124)
 runpy.run_path(str(SCRIPT),run_name='__main__')
 assert len(calls)==1


def test_per_group_quota_unchanged(setup):
 f,start=setup;calls=start(baseline=[{'native_mode':'L','group':'author-one'}]*8)
 runpy.run_path(str(SCRIPT),run_name='__main__')
